title: Wire production child accounting + enforce the C1 job-object containment gate in the start launch path
objective: QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (supervisor-freeze section 2/3): M0-T052 G5 security review (project-control/reports/M0-T052-g5-security.md) SEC-MAJOR - demonstrated security risk: (a) record_launched_child (recovery.py:181) has NO production caller, so recover_boot's surviving-child fail-closed is inert in production (the runner spawns via subprocess.Popen + container.adopt at claude_runner.py:965-971 without journaling the pid); (b) kill-on-close containment is platform-conditional (Job Object only) and cmd_start has no fail-closed containment gate, so on non-Job-Object hosts a stranded-START_CLAUDE resume (M0-T052) could double-launch over an orphaned worker. SCOPE (smallest durable set, G5 C1+C2 verbatim): (1) call record_launched_child at worker spawn and clear_child_record on verified clean exit, in the production launch path, so a surviving recorded child forces UNSAFE_OR_DRIFTED refusal on resume; (2) enforce the C1 activation pin fail-closed IN THE START LAUNCH PATH: refuse supervised dispatch when the host's default containment is not the Job Object (doctor-parity check at cmd_start/loop construction), with an explicit refusal reason; (3) correct nothing else - no redesign (D-010-R240 pattern). REQUIRED TESTS: surviving-recorded-child refusal now exercised through the PRODUCTION recording path (spawn->record->kill supervisor->resume refuses); clean-exit clears the record and the subsequent resume proceeds; non-job-object containment refuses supervised dispatch fail-closed with the recorded reason; full supervisor suite re-establishes the M0-T052 baseline (1402 passed/2 skipped) plus the new tests, 0 failures.
business_reason: M0-T052 G5 required corrections C1 (host containment precondition, launch-path enforcement) and C2 (child-accounting wiring) - BLOCKING for continued supervised-auto operation beyond the verified Job-Object host; closes the double-launch residual so protection does not rest on kill-on-close alone.
